_note: Sample listings inbox emails (3 Nov 2026) in the shape citations/inbox/gmail.js get() returns after decoding: headers, text, html. Built from the directories' real email patterns; no real client data. The fixture wraps them in the Gmail API's message format for the fake API. Every message carries Gmail's Authentication-Results header; m-yell-spoof fails SPF and DKIM; m-plus-address uses the plus form of the client address.
